dataset.policy: per-chunk pgbench -i -s 10, CHECKPOINT + VACUUM (ANALYZE) before each measured block, bloat accounting per chunk

pooler_config:
# PgBouncer M1 baseline (transaction mode)
# refs: config.html, features.html, faq.html
[pgbouncer]
listen_addr = 127.0.0.1
listen_port = 6433
pool_mode = transaction
default_pool_size = 10
max_client_conn = 500
min_pool_size = 0
reserve_pool_size = 0
reserve_pool_timeout = 5.0
# client auth (config.html Authentication settings):
# scram-sha-256 against users.txt (plaintext benchpass entry,
# CI-only). PgBouncer logs into PostgreSQL with the client's
# password, so the benchuser/benchpass pair that pgbench
# presents (PGPASSWORD in CI) also authenticates the backend.
auth_type = scram-sha-256
auth_file = /home/runner/work/RandomLabs/RandomLabs/poolduel/results/m9-m9r10/work-M1-2-pgbouncer-r10/users.txt
server_reset_query = DISCARD ALL
server_lifetime = 3600.0
server_idle_timeout = 600.0
query_wait_timeout = 120.0
so_reuseport = 0
max_prepared_statements = 0

[databases]
benchdb = host=127.0.0.1 port=5432 dbname=benchdb
